title: Salt Lake Scavenger Hunt with Tacos and Drinks
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Salt Lake City's vibrant taco scene with the SLC Epic Taco Crawl. Enjoy four signature tacos from the city's top taco joints, paired with a refreshing drink and a sweet treat of mini churros. This self-guided adventure allows you to explore the downtown area's murals and local businesses at your own pace, all while engaging in a fun scavenger hunt. Perfect for food lovers and those looking to explore local culture, this crawl should take about 90 minutes to complete. 

- Savor 4 premium tacos from must-try taco spots
- Includes a drink of your choice and mini churros
- Explore with a self-guided app, available for 6 months
- Engage in a local landmark scavenger hunt with a prize opportunity
